in_marathi.name: Paridhi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Paridhi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Paridhi is a Sanskrit name derived from the root 'paridh' meaning 'to bestow'. It signifies a gift, something that is bestowed upon an individual or a situation. In Hindu mythology, Paridhi is the name of a celestial nymph, a giver of blessings and boons.

She is also known as the goddess of auspiciousness and is invoked during various rituals and ceremonies to ensure the success and prosperity of the event.
